name: Washi
author: AkiraYuki587
description: Washi is a warm paper-collage Textus theme: ruled kraft paper, diagonal washi tape, highlighter gradients on headings and links, and sticky-note callouts. Original palette; the :root:root window-color pin is adapted from Misty (myshzzx / E-Tiger Studio, MIT) with thanks.

zh.description: 手帐 Washi：牛皮方格纸底、斜贴纸胶带、马克笔/荧光笔渐变标题与链接下划线、便利贴式引用与任务框。原创配色与实现；仅借 Misty（myshzzx 投稿 / E-Tiger Studio / Typora Misty，MIT）的 :root:root 钉色技巧并致谢。单一浅色外观，仅一张渲染预览图。
